title: DotheThing: An incredibly capable terminal-native autonomous AI agent

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: An incredibly capable terminal native autonomous AI agent. Doth the thing is built by Ricardo Spangni, former lead maintainer of Monero. Tagline, you describe the thing, it does the thing. A full stack operator searches the web via CRXNG. Bypasses bot detection with Camu Fox. Runs shell commands. Sends and receives emails through agent mail. Farms easy work to cheap models. autonomously upgrades to GPT 5.5 when stuck.
